shots.headline: Agency, freelancer or DIY?
shots.line: Mhoro! Agency, freelancer, or build it yourself?

cards: Cheapest, but it costs your time.
Can be great. Get a contract.
shots.headline: Each has its place
shots.line: DIY is cheapest, but it costs your time. A freelancer can be great, just get a contract. An agency gives you a team and aftercare.

shots.title: Whoever you choose, ask:
shots.headline: Three questions to ask
shots.line: Whoever you choose, ask three things: who owns the domain, is the price in writing, and who fixes it after launch?
Ask us anything. Book a free call. Tatenda!
